description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git svn dcommit' functionality with a Subversion repository. It includes setup commands for starting a local SVN server, initializing a git svn repository, creating files, and running commands to verify integration between git and SVN.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Ensures that an SVN server is running and accessible for testing purposes.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts a local SVN server for testing.
